name: Bat and Bear: College Days
source:
With two perspectives on the same story; you'll follow either Bat or Bear as they learn how to navigate the difficulties that come with col, and watch the two form a connection with each other over the course of a year.

[From [url=https://yonkbonkers.itch.io/college-days-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对同一个故事有两种观点；你将跟随Bat或Bear学习如何应对Col带来的困难，并在一年的时间里观察两者之间建立的联系。

[来自[url=https://yonkbonkers.itch.io/college-days-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
